description: In the heart of historic Paris, ideally located between the Louvre and Montorgueil, on the edge of the Marais, our apartment will allow you to explore the capital's most beautiful neighbourhoods and monuments on foot.With its 68 m² and various living areas, it offers all the comfort you need to spend time with family or friends, relax and fully enjoy the unique atmosphere of Paris.The spaceUpon arrival, you'll quickly feel at home in this cosy, contemporary and carefully furnished apartment. Entirely reserved for your use, it offers several comfortable spaces so that everyone can get together, relax or enjoy a bit of peace and quiet.The accommodation includes:• A pleasant 30 m² living room, ideal for sharing good times. You will find a fully equipped kitchen, a cosy dining area, a double sofa bed, a TV and a library for your moments of relaxation. The room has heating and an eco-friendly air conditioning system.• A large 18 m² bedroom with a king-size bed, designed as a real haven for relaxing after a wonderful day in Paris. It also has heating and an eco-friendly air conditioning system.• A third air-conditioned area comprising a living room with a large double sofa bed, extended by a flexible bedroom equipped with a double bed and a single bed. A soundproof blackout curtain makes it easy to separate the two spaces and preserve everyone's privacy.The flat is very well heated in winter. During the summer months, the eco-friendly air conditioning systems are supplemented by mobile air conditioning units when temperatures rise.Whether you're travelling with family, friends or for work, everyone can enjoy their own space while sharing pleasant moments in a welcoming, comfortable flat that's perfectly suited to a stay in Paris.Here, Paris is best explored on foot!
